subject: Password expires in 4 hours
body: This is a system-generated notification. Your network password is scheduled to expire in 4 hours and will be locked unless you confirm it now. Access to email, the internal portal, and the finance system will be suspended until your account is verified. Please confirm your password by replying to this message immediately to avoid an interruption. Do not contact the IT department, this is the final automated reminder. If you are busy, delegate this to a colleague within your team so the account remains active.
indicators: asks to reply with the password
hook: Imposes a short hard deadline and threatens a real consequence (account lock) that IT staff genuinely face.
